Q: Remove multi-line comments A:

Use an awk range (https://www.gnu.org/software/gawk/manual/gawk.html#Ranges) to find the lines containing multi-line strings, then delete them with sed.

# exclude starting patterns that are single line comments
# convert the resulting list of line numbers into a format that sed can use
cat $FILE \
| awk '/\/\*[^*]+$/,/\*\//{print NR "d"}' \
| tr '\n' ';' \
| xargs -IX sed --in-place 'X' $FILE

Q: 'Array Literal' Error in Google Sheets - Not getting the desired output A:

modern approach:

=LET(a, FILTER(ClassA!A2:B, ClassA!C2:C=B7, ClassA!E2:E>=B1, ClassA!E2:E<=B2),
     b, FILTER(ClassB!A2:B, ClassB!C2:C=B7, ClassB!E2:E>=B1, ClassB!E2:E<=B2),
     IF(B3="ClassA", a, 
     IF(B3="ClassB", b, 
     IF(B3="All", QUERY(IFNA(VSTACK(a, b)), "where Col1 is not null", )

 "where Col1 is not null", ))
